+import pefile,hashlib,struct
+p=pefile.PE('artifacts/hard_vm/vm_guard.exe')
+key=p.get_data(0x1a000,1)[0]
+enc=p.get_data(0x1e000,0xf3)

+    out.append(b^key)

+targets={}
